vision.prompt: The robot has a camera and depth sensor for computer vision. You can ask the robot to detect objects, find specific colors/shapes, or estimate distances. Use the detect_objects tool to get object positions and identities. You can also ask the robot to look around or inspect the environment.

tools.name: detect_objects
tools.description: Detect objects in the camera feed. Returns array of objects with id, name, confidence, bounding box, and distance.

target.description: Optional target object to search for (e.g., 'tomato', 'red ball', 'person')

tools.name: get_environment
tools.description: Get current environment state including obstacles, floor plan, and spatial relationships.
